newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp debt tightens a touch on rating action.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp debt tightens a touch on rating action.

text.p: Spreads on Citicorp's bonds tightened two basis points in secondary market trading following news that Moody's Investors Service may raise its debt ratings, high-grade traders said on Tuesday.
"Spreads on Citicorp paper are two basis points tighter after the rating action," said one bank & finance trader.
Moody's said on Tuesday it placed the A1 long-term debt and A2 subordinated debt ratings under review for possible upgrade.

The rating agency said the review will focus on the prospective performance of Citicorp's multiple business franchises, the company's risk profile and risk mangement procedures and strategic plans and actions.
